title: A slot binding needs exactly one operator
accepts: a binding with exactly one of gate, chain or fan-out

title: A build identity with an unknown source state is refused
accepts: clean, the source state of the current build

title: A revision that is not a full commit ID is refused before any download
refuses: main: installation fails and makes no API call

title: The SDK inventory digest follows the contents and refuses links
accepts: An SDK folder of plain files, whose digest changes when a file's mode changes.
refuses: A folder with a symlink, or more files or bytes than the limits allow.
notes: Not proof yet: nothing ties the digest to an official Go release.
